title: pimpinella handelii
intro: Pimpinella handelii, commonly known as Handel's burns plant or Bunium handelii, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to protect against oxidative stress, inflammation, and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Pimpinella handelii are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids. Research on the plant has identified seselin, pimpinellin, and bergapten as its primary bioactive compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
